adjudication.rationale: The embed view does call `post.user.small_avatar_url` and `post.user.username` without a nil-check, but the diff does not show (or change) any behavior that would make `post.user` nil. In typical Discourse data model `posts.user_id` is required and a "deleted" user generally still has a User row (soft-deleted/anonymized), so `post.user` would still exist. The claim that deletion causes `NoMethodError` is not verifiable from this diff and is speculative about application behavior outside the shown changes.
